rust_tracing_text_log.title: Rust tracing text format
rust_tracing_text_log.description: The default text format of the tracing-subscriber crate for Rust, as written by `tracing_subscriber::fmt::init()`.  The timestamps can be the time since the program started, like cargo's `CARGO_LOG` output.  The clock time for those comes from an event in the first second whose message is only a timestamp, like cargo's `start="2026-11-08T17:19:17.280527Z"`.

thread.description: The name of the thread, when the subscriber is configured with `with_thread_names(true)`

thread_id.description: The ID of the thread, when the subscriber is configured with `with_thread_ids(true)`

spans.description: The spans that the event is in, from the outermost to the innermost, with their fields

target.description: The target of the event, which is the Rust module that generated it, unless it was set with `target:`

file.description: The source file of the event, when the subscriber is configured with `with_file(true)`

line.description: The line number of the event, when the subscriber is configured with `with_line_number(true)`
